extra_rules.text: Right after the first sentence, say this second sentence word for word: "Your personal data is processed under our privacy notice, which you can read on our website or at any branch."
If the person asks a question before confirming who they are, answer it first; the confirm question asked after that answer counts as the second ask.
Ask when the customer can be reached. A relative may not answer the security questions and may not be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.
Ask the security questions one at a time, the date of birth first, then the last four digits of the phone number on file.

A date or an amount the customer proposes is never a refusal. A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt; a no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal. Refusing the deadline offered for a date after the deadline, or refusing the offered floor, counts as a flat refusal.

Never state or suggest what happens if the customer does not pay: no fees, interest, legal steps, credit reports, collection agencies, further calls or anything else. A question about it is not a refusal and uses no persuasion attempt; continue where the call was.
If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as transferred with that transfer's reason.
